caption: The video showcases an indoor rug-cleaning workshop where a rectangular, shaggy beige rug lies partly saturated with white soapy foam on a large white tarp. A person wearing white rubber boots and dark trousers stands at the far end of the rug, gripping a long-handled tool with a flat metal head. Throughout the excerpt the metal head stays at the rug's far edge, drifting slowly leftward rather than traveling down the rug's length toward the camera, while the operator's boots remain roughly in place. A mound of white suds gathers and grows at the head as the operator works it, and the long handle tilts from nearly vertical to a more diagonal angle. The rug's body keeps its mottled beige-and-foam pattern, with the foamy region ahead of the head unchanged. A pool of foam and water fills the foreground below the rug, showing only minor surface ripples. A blue air-mover fan, cleaning machines, bottles and a red cone stay fixed in the background. The camera remains static, capturing this ongoing agitation at the rug's far edge without showing how it began or where it ends.
relations: Operator's boots remain roughly in place while the metal tool head drifts leftward at the rug's far edge.
The metal head's agitation causes a mound of white suds to gather and grow at the rug's far edge.
The operator's working motion tilts the long handle from nearly vertical to a more diagonal angle.
The rug's body maintains its mottled beige-and-foam pattern, with the foamy region ahead of the head unchanged.
